headline: Frequent Rework of Text Editing Features
diagnosis: The commit history indicates a recurring theme of fixes and feature additions related to text editing, particularly in the editor component. The high number of fix/revert commits suggests that changes are not being fully validated before merging, leading to instability in the text editing functionality.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of recent text editing commits to identify common issues and patterns causing rework.
Establish a dedicated testing suite for text editing features to catch regressions before commits are merged.
Implement a code review checklist focused on text editing changes to ensure all edge cases are considered.
Assign a single owner or small team to oversee text editing features to improve accountability and reduce bus factor.
owner_hint: Consider appointing a lead developer for text editing features.
